structured_output.summary:
The finding was real: every existing HUD-motion stage synced either on the event tick (since = 0) or at since = 10, so if EVENT_TICKS were shortened to 1, every test would still pass. In the game, though, the bump, roll and stamp would then come off on the next frame. Product code is unchanged; the fix pins the 10-tick window with tests.

Changes:
- In src/ui/stages/hud-motion.stage.ts I added an `everyTick(from, to, racers)` helper that syncs once per tick, like the game does. I also added two stages: 'overtake-late' (the overtake, then syncs at 1202–1210, so since = 9) and 'new-lap-late' (the new lap, then syncs at 2423–2431). I updated the header comment to match.
- The new test file tests/ui/hud-motion-window.test.ts checks in Chromium that the Pos panel and its digit (overtake-late) and the Lap panel (new-lap-late) still compute a non-none animation at since = 9. Together with the existing AC4 check at since = 10, the window is pinned to exactly 10 ticks.

Red/green: I temporarily set `const EVENT_TICKS = 1;` and both new tests failed, then restored the original line and both passed. Before this change the tests would also fail because the stages didn't exist. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes all 738 tests in 110 files.
